=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:278 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, x-ai_grok-4_20, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Hand-back step 1 deletes the safety-net trigger by ID without instructing the session to call `get_trigger` to verify its `name` and `persistent_session_id` before deletion.
  WHY: The safety-net ID comes from the arming report, an ID source §26.I requires checking; without verification, a stale or repurposed ID could delete a trigger owned by another session.
- CLAUDE.md:§26.D terminal path, lines 1984-1985 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The terminal-path fixer instruction deletes the fired hand-back Routine by ID without instructing a `get_trigger` ownership check.
  WHY: §26.I explicitly requires checking a checker's own hand-back trigger before deletion; although practical risk is described as low, the rule makes no exception for fired Routines.
- CLAUDE.md:§26.C step 5 "Terminal, fixer gone" fallback, line 1953 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The fallback deletes the fixer's hand-back Routine by ID without the `get_trigger` ownership verification required by §26.I.
  WHY: §26.I covers a checker's own hand-back trigger as an ID source requiring verification, but the fallback deletes it without that check.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
